verdict.rationale: Modal's marketing docs claim sandboxes 'spin up fresh, isolated sandboxes programmatically' and can launch 'hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds,' implying fast cold starts, but there are no explicit benchmark numbers (e.g., sub-second latency figures) documented anywhere in the evidence pack. Community mentions (self-hosted runners, MCP-JS gRPC control) imply usable startup speed but don't quantify cold-start times either. missing for 10: concrete documented cold-start latency benchmarks (sub-second to few-second figures), independent performance testing corroborating claimed speed.
